name: Campwell
tagline: Offsites your whole team actually looks forward to.
positioning: Campwell helps small teams plan, book, and run corporate offsites without a full-time events person — from venue to agenda to the ride home.

hero.h1: Plan the offsite without becoming the offsite planner.
hero.sub: Campwell turns the chaos of venue emails, dietary spreadsheets, and last-minute flight changes into one calm checklist — so owner-operators can lead the retreat instead of babysitting it.

features.title: Venue matchmaking
features.description: Tell us your headcount, budget, and vibe. Campwell surfaces vetted cabins, lodges, and meeting spaces with real availability — no more 14-email back-and-forth per property.

features.title: Agenda builder
features.description: Drag sessions, meals, and free time onto a shared schedule. Everyone sees the same living itinerary, and changes sync to their phones instantly.

features.title: Budget tracker
features.description: Every deposit, flight, and dinner rolls into one running total against your cap. Export a clean summary your bookkeeper will actually thank you for.

features.title: Travel & logistics
features.description: Collect arrival times, assign rides, and hand out room keys digitally. Campwell flags the person landing at 11pm before it becomes your problem.

features.title: Headcount & dietary
features.description: One RSVP link captures allergies, room preferences, and plus-ones. No more decoding a spreadsheet at the caterer's counter.

features.title: Reusable playbooks
features.description: Save last year's retreat as a template. Next offsite starts at 80% done instead of a blank page and a knot in your stomach.

testimonials.quote: We're 22 people and I'm also the CEO. Campwell took the annual retreat off my plate in a weekend. The budget tracker alone kept us from blowing past our cap like last year.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The shared itinerary ended the endless 'wait, when's dinner?' Slack pings. My team showed up rested, on time, and genuinely excited. That never happened when I ran it on spreadsheets.
testimonials.name: Danny Okafor

testimonials.quote: I planned our first offsite in eight years because Campwell made it feel doable. The venue matchmaking found us a lodge under budget in about ten minutes.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For small teams running one offsite a year.
For growing teams that gather more than once.
For multi-location companies with recurring retreats.

homepage.footerBlurb: Campwell is the offsite planner for owner-operators who'd rather lead the retreat than run the logistics. Warmer gatherings, fewer spreadsheets.
